errors.error_description: Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential block by using a blocking assignment to ptr inside an always_ff block.
Assigned an 11-bit concatenation to an 8-bit signal dbg_bus, causing truncation of upper bits.
Declared an escaped identifier using a SystemVerilog keyword (\logic) as a signal name.
